correctness.rationale: Exact Nauru edge definition yields 24 vertices and 36 edges. Independently recomputed all-pairs distances, 60 MMD pairs and their two K4 square K3 rook components. MMD vertex-cover necessity proves 18 lower bound; all 576 upper-bound candidates directly strongly resolve all 276 vertex pairs. Exhaustively enumerated all candidate bases and 1,728 exchanges. Explicit 24-vertex star-permutation bijection and complete 576 by 576 exchange checks prove reconfiguration is GP(12,5) Cartesian-square, with verified all-source distance distribution and sharp diameter eight. All three standalone programs and finite certificates are included and replayed.

value.rationale: The exact self-product identity for reconfiguration of optimal resolving landmark configurations is a structural theorem about mobility of all optimal solutions. It determines all 576 optima, reachability, and a sharp eight-jump bound from a natural 24-vertex cubic arc-transitive graph; it is not just a textbook consequence or isolated unmotivated small count. The rook geometry and Cayley-permutation equivalence explain the phenomenon and provide a concrete test case for metric-basis reconfiguration, without asserting unproved extensions.
